Metadata.title: Clara
Metadata.description: Clara — AI-native Agentic Accounting OS for Malaysian accounting firms.

FirmHome.heading: Firm home
FirmHome.body: P1 foundation scaffold — the firm-altitude workspace (Needs-you inbox, client register, firm activity, admin) is built in P3/P4. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

NeedsYou.heading: Needs you
NeedsYou.body: P2 shell — the cross-client Needs-you inbox is built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

ClientsRegister.heading: Clients
ClientsRegister.body: P2 shell — the client register (every client the firm serves) is built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

FirmActivity.heading: Activity
FirmActivity.body: P2 shell — the firm activity/receipts feed is built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

Admin.heading: Admin
Admin.body: P2 shell — users, capabilities and the metering rollup are built in P4. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

ClientWorkspace.heading: Client workspace
ClientWorkspace.body: P1 foundation scaffold — the client workspace tabs (journals, documents, bank, close, reports, registers, knowledge) are built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

CommandPalette.description: Go to a page, ask Clara, or dispatch a run.

JournalsWorkbench.heading: Journals
JournalsWorkbench.noSession: Sign in to view this client's journals.
JournalsWorkbench.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again to view this client's journals.
JournalsWorkbench.forbidden: You don't have permission to view this client's journals.
JournalsWorkbench.notFound: Journals are not available for this client right now.

linesEditor.notBalanced: Debits and credits don't match yet — the DB will refuse an unbalanced entry on submit.

compose.title: New journal entry
compose.description: A manual entry — recorded via record_client_resolution + draft_entry, the DB's own manual-compose ceremony.

drafts.empty: No drafts are waiting for review.
drafts.showingOf: Showing {shown} of {total} drafts — some may be hidden behind a large backlog in another category. Narrow the queue to see the rest.
drafts.entryUnavailable: This entry could not be read — it may have changed since the queue was last loaded.
drafts.presentationSumUnavailable: Totals unavailable — too many lines to verify
drafts.linesTruncated: This client has more lines than could be safely read at once — the totals below cannot be verified and are withheld.

posted.presentationSumUnavailable: unavailable — too many lines to verify
posted.alreadyReversed: This entry has already been reversed.
posted.isReversal: This entry is itself a reversal — a reversal cannot be reversed.

ClientDocuments.heading: Documents
ClientDocuments.body: P2 shell — upload, OCR, the evidence viewer, correction and filing are built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

ClientBank.heading: Bank
ClientBank.body: P2 shell — accounts, statements, matching and reconciliation are built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

ClientClose.heading: Close
ClientClose.body: P2 shell — the three close keys and the agent-act receipt panel are built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

ClientReports.heading: Reports
ClientReports.body: P2 shell — statutory close reports, flexible/generative reports and the agent-receipt panel are built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

ClientRegisters.heading: Registers
ClientRegisters.body: P2 shell — AR/AP aging, fixed assets, adjustments, staff advances and accounts are built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

ClientKnowledge.heading: Knowledge
ClientKnowledge.body: P2 shell — the knowledge/data-library surface is built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.
